Feedback

The main haircut doubts, handled before the salon

Users mostly come in with the same problems: they cannot describe the style clearly, do not know what suits them, and do not want to regret a real haircut. These are the problems Best-Haircut helps them resolve first.

"I kept delaying my haircut because I could not tell whether shorter hair would actually suit me. Seeing the change on my own face removed most of the guesswork, so I booked with a much clearer plan."

Maya
Was afraid a shorter cut would look wrong on her face

"Random inspiration photos always led to vague conversations because none of them really looked like me. One preview image fixed that. I could finally show my barber a direction that matched my own face."

Daniel
Kept struggling to explain what he wanted to his barber

"I usually overthink changes like bangs because it is hard to picture the final shape. The preview let me compare lengths calmly first, instead of gambling on a haircut and hoping it worked."

Lina
Wanted to test bangs without making an expensive mistake

"I used to bring celebrity reference photos that did not match my face shape or hairline, so the result was always open to interpretation. This gave me a realistic reference based on me, which made the salon discussion much more precise."

Kevin
Needed a practical reference instead of celebrity photos

"Before cutting off a lot of length, I wanted one more layer of certainty. The preview did not make the decision for me, but it helped me rule out bad directions before I paid for a real cut."

Nina
Wanted confidence before making a big change

"I was not looking for anything dramatic. I wanted a style that looked cleaner but was still easy to live with. The previews helped me narrow it down fast without wasting time on unrealistic ideas."

Jason
Only wanted styles he could actually maintain every day
